The '''Duros resistance''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] resistance movement, led by [[Jenssar SoBilles]] on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. It later became part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
